# verifactu-sdk

TypeScript/JavaScript SDK for Spain's AEAT VERI*FACTU electronic invoicing system.
Implements Real Decreto 1007/2023 and Orden HAC/1177/2024.

- Repository: https://github.com/eloi24/verifactu-sdk
- Docs: https://eloi24.github.io/verifactu-sdk/
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/verifactu-sdk
- License: MIT
- Author: Eloi Baulenas <eloibaucid24@gmail.com>

## Install

```bash
bun add verifactu-sdk
# or
npm i verifactu-sdk
```

Runtime: Bun 1.3.14 or Node ≥ 20.

## Core concept

Every invoice submitted to AEAT must:
1. Be validated against Zod schemas mirroring the official XSDs.
2. Have a SHA-256 chained hash (`Huella`) computed over 8 specific fields.
3. Be wrapped in a SOAP 1.1 Document/Literal envelope.
4. Be sent via HTTPS with a qualified electronic certificate (mTLS).
5. Include a mandatory tax QR code on the printed/digital invoice.

The SDK handles all of this. You provide the invoice data in English-named fields;
the SDK maps to AEAT Spanish wire format internally.

## VerifactuClient — main entry point

```typescript
import { VerifactuClient } from 'verifactu-sdk';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';

const client = new VerifactuClient({
  environment: 'preproduction', // or 'production'
  mode: 'verifactu',            // or 'onRequest' (under AEAT requirement)
  certificate: {
    pfx: readFileSync('./cert.pfx'),
    passphrase: process.env.CERT_PASS,
  },
  taxpayer: {
    nif: 'B12345678',
    legalName: 'My Company SL',
  },
  billingSystem: {
    producerName: 'My Company SL',
    nif: 'B12345678',
    systemName: 'My Billing App',
    systemId: 'MB',       // 2 chars [A-Z0-9]
    version: '1.0.0',
    installationNumber: '0001',
    onlyVerifactu: 'S',   // 'S' or 'N'
    multipleTaxpayer: 'N',
    hasMultipleTaxpayers: 'N',
  },
  // hashStore: new InMemoryHashStore(), // default; provide your own for persistence
});
```

### Register an invoice (alta)

```typescript
import type { Invoice } from 'verifactu-sdk';

const invoice: Invoice = {
  invoiceId: {
    issuerNif: 'B12345678',
    seriesNumber: 'A/2026/0001',  // max 60 chars, no " ' < = >
    issueDate: '2026-05-20',       // ISO YYYY-MM-DD, ≥ 2024-10-28
  },
  issuerName: 'My Company SL',
  invoiceType: 'F1',              // F1=standard, F2=simplified, F3=summary, R1-R5=rectifying
  description: 'Consulting services',
  recipients: [
    { nif: '12345678Z', legalName: 'Customer SL' },
  ],
  breakdown: [{
    tax: '01',                    // '01'=VAT, '02'=IPSI, '03'=IGIC, '05'=other
    regimeKey: '01',              // '01'=general, '02'=export, '03'=REBU, etc.
    operationQualification: 'S1', // S1=taxable, S2=reverse-charge, N1/N2=non-subject
    taxRate: '21',                // percentage as string
    taxBase: '100.00',
    taxAmount: '21.00',
  }],
  totalTaxAmount: '21.00',
  totalAmount: '121.00',
  billingSystem: { /* same as client config */ },
  generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  chainLink: { first: true },     // SDK fills this from HashStore automatically
  hash: '',                       // SDK computes this automatically
};

const response = await client.registerInvoice(invoice);
// response.csv       — AEAT verification code (store it!)
// response.waitSeconds — honour this before the next submission
// response.envelopeState — 'Correcto' | 'ParcialmenteCorrecto' | 'Incorrecto'
// response.records   — per-invoice outcome array
```

### Cancel an invoice (anulación)

```typescript
import type { CancelInvoiceInput } from 'verifactu-sdk';

const cancellation: CancelInvoiceInput = {
  cancelledInvoiceId: {
    issuerNif: 'B12345678',
    seriesNumber: 'A/2026/0001',
    issueDate: '2026-05-20',
  },
  generatedBy: 'E',               // E=issuer, D=recipient, T=third party
  billingSystem: { /* ... */ },
  generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  chainLink: { first: false },    // SDK fills automatically
  hash: '',                       // SDK computes automatically
};

const response = await client.cancelInvoice(cancellation);
```

### Query submitted invoices (VERI*FACTU mode only)

```typescript
for await (const page of client.queryInvoices({ year: '2026', period: '05' })) {
  for (const record of page.records) {
    console.log(record.invoiceId.seriesNumber, record.state, record.lastModifiedAt);
  }
  // page.nextCursor — present when more pages exist (handled automatically)
}
```

### Render the mandatory tax QR

```typescript
// From a registered invoice response:
const qrPng = await client.renderQr(
  {
    nif: 'B12345678',
    seriesNumber: 'A/2026/0001',
    issueDate: '2026-05-20',
    totalAmount: '121.00',
  },
  { format: 'png', sizeMm: 35 },  // format: 'png' | 'svg' | 'dataurl'
);
// qrPng.url     — the verification URL embedded in the QR
// qrPng.payload — Buffer (PNG) or string (SVG/DataURL)
```

### Batch submission (up to 1 000 records per envelope)

```typescript
const invoices: Invoice[] = [ /* ... */ ];
for await (const response of client.registerBatch(invoices)) {
  console.log(response.envelopeState, response.records.length);
}
```

## HashStore — persistence across process restarts

The SDK chains every invoice hash to the previous one. By default it uses
`InMemoryHashStore` (lost on restart). Provide your own for production:

```typescript
import type { HashStore, HashStoreEntry } from 'verifactu-sdk';

class PostgresHashStore implements HashStore {
  async getLast(taxpayerNif: string): Promise<HashStoreEntry | null> {
    return db.query('SELECT * FROM hash_chain WHERE nif=$1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1', [taxpayerNif]);
  }
  async append(taxpayerNif: string, entry: HashStoreEntry): Promise<void> {
    await db.query('INSERT INTO hash_chain(nif, invoice_id, hash) VALUES($1,$2,$3)',
      [taxpayerNif, JSON.stringify(entry.invoiceId), entry.hash]);
  }
}

const client = new VerifactuClient({ /* ... */ hashStore: new PostgresHashStore() });
```

## Standalone validators

```typescript
import { validateInvoiceForRegister, isValidNif, isValidEuVatNumber } from 'verifactu-sdk/validators';

const errors = validateInvoiceForRegister(invoice);
// errors[].severity: 'rejection' | 'admissible'
// errors[].code:     AEAT error code e.g. '1108'
// errors[].field:    dotted path e.g. 'invoiceId.issuerNif'
// errors[].message:  English description

isValidNif('12345678Z');                    // true/false — Spanish DNI/NIE/CIF
isValidEuVatNumber('DE', '123456789');      // true/false — EU VAT number
```

## Error handling

```typescript
import {
  SchemaValidationError,
  BusinessValidationError,
  SoapFaultError,
  NetworkError,
} from 'verifactu-sdk';

try {
  await client.registerInvoice(invoice);
} catch (err) {
  if (err instanceof SchemaValidationError) {
    // Zod/XSD validation failed before SOAP call
    console.error(err.field, err.message);
  } else if (err instanceof BusinessValidationError) {
    // AEAT business rule violated locally (e.g. wrong date, forbidden char in seriesNumber)
    console.error(err.code, err.field, err.message);
  } else if (err instanceof SoapFaultError) {
    // AEAT returned a <soapenv:Fault> (envelope-level error)
    console.error(err.code, err.faultstring);
  } else if (err instanceof NetworkError) {
    // Transport/TLS failure
    console.error(err.status, err.retryable);
  }
}
```

## Error catalog

```typescript
import { ERROR_CATALOG } from 'verifactu-sdk';

const entry = ERROR_CATALOG['1108'];
// entry.category:      'record'
// entry.message:       'El NIF del IDEmisorFactura debe ser el mismo que el NIF del ObligadoEmision.'
// entry.englishMessage: 'The issuer NIF must match the taxpayer NIF in the header.'
```

248 codes organized in three categories:
- `envelope` (4xxx) — rejects the entire submission
- `record` (1xxx, 3xxx) — rejects the specific invoice
- `admissible` (2xxx) — accepted with warning, must be corrected later

## Standalone QR helpers

```typescript
import { buildQrUrl, renderQrPng } from 'verifactu-sdk/qr';

const url = buildQrUrl({
  nif: 'B12345678',
  numSerieFactura: 'A/2026/0001',
  fechaExpedicionFactura: '2026-05-20', // ISO YYYY-MM-DD
  importeTotal: '121.00',
  mode: 'verifactu',       // or 'on-request'
  environment: 'production', // or 'preproduction'
});

const png = await renderQrPng(url, { sizeMm: 35 });
```

## Standalone hash helpers

```typescript
import { computeRegistroAltaHash, computeRegistroAnulacionHash } from 'verifactu-sdk/hash';
// These operate on the Spanish wire types (RegistroAlta, RegistroAnulacion).
// Normally you don't call them directly — VerifactuClient handles this.
```

## Invoice types reference

| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| F1   | Standard invoice |
| F2   | Simplified invoice (ticket) — total ≤ 3 000 € |
| F3   | Invoice summary |
| R1   | Rectifying invoice (legal/economic cause) |
| R2   | Rectifying — insolvency proceedings |
| R3   | Rectifying — bad debt |
| R4   | Rectifying — other |
| R5   | Rectifying simplified |

## Regime keys (ClaveRegimen) for VAT

| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| 01   | General |
| 02   | Export |
| 03   | Special scheme used goods (REBU) |
| 04   | Gold investment |
| 05   | Travel agencies |
| 06   | Group of entities (advanced) |
| 07   | Cash accounting |
| 08   | Non-subject by localisation rules |
| 09   | Travel |
| 10   | Collections on behalf of third parties |
| 11   | Business premises rental |
| 14   | VAT pending AEAT (public sector) |
| 15   | Intra-community acquisitions |

## Environments and endpoints

| Mode         | Environment    | Endpoint |
|--------------|---------------|----------|
| verifactu    | preproduction | https://prewww1.aeat.es/wlpl/TIKE-CONT/ws/SistemaFacturacion/VerifactuSOAP |
| verifactu    | production    | https://www1.agenciatributaria.gob.es/wlpl/TIKE-CONT/ws/SistemaFacturacion/VerifactuSOAP |
| onRequest    | preproduction | https://prewww1.aeat.es/wlpl/TIKE-CONT/ws/SistemaFacturacion/NoVerifactuSOAP |
| onRequest    | production    | https://www1.agenciatributaria.gob.es/wlpl/TIKE-CONT/ws/SistemaFacturacion/NoVerifactuSOAP |

## Key constraints from the AEAT spec

- Maximum 1 000 records per SOAP envelope.
- `TiempoEsperaEnvio`: initial wait = 60 s between submissions; the AEAT updates it in each response.
- `seriesNumber` (NumSerieFactura): max 60 chars, ASCII 32-126 only, no `"`, `'`, `<`, `=`, `>`.
- `issueDate` must be ≥ 2024-10-28 (entry into force of the regulation).
- `issueDate` cannot be in the future.
- `totalAmount` (ImporteTotal) must match sum of breakdown lines ± 10 €.
- `totalTaxAmount` (CuotaTotal) must match sum of taxAmount lines ± 10 €.
- If `totalAmount` ≥ 100 000 000 €, set `macroData: 'S'`.
- For F2 (simplified) invoices without billing agreement: (taxBase + taxAmount) ≤ 3 000 €.
- Hash chain: the first record of a taxpayer sets `chainLink: { first: true }`;
  all subsequent records reference the previous hash automatically via `HashStore`.
